system.description:
Barbarians are primal warriors that fight with the power of unbridled anger. The legends speak of their kills almost as their own unique deeds, using the barbarian’s name as a past-tense verb.


Iconic Barbarians

• Brock Samson, The Venture Bros.

• Conan, Conan the Barbarian

• Guts, Berserk

• Logen Ninefingers, First Law Trilogy


Playing Barbarian

The barbarian is a mid-high-defense bruiser. Stick to an Enemy, and hit them very hard.


Action: Attack (Melee)

Move: Frontline


Training: Melee, Survival

features.name: Rage
features.description:
While Berserk, your attack damage dice are one size larger and can Explode, and you reduce damage you take by 1 per damage die if you are wearing Light or no Armor.


Further, you can go Berserk when you take damage or attack an Enemy. You remain Berserk this way for 1 minute, or until you end your Turn without attacking an Enemy or taking damage since your last Turn.

features.name: Wrath
features.description: You gain the Interceptor Perk (p. 69), and can make its attack against an Enemy that takes an Action.

features.name: Aggressor
features.description: You have a 10’ bonus to Speed during the first Round of Combat, and having 3 or more Fatigue doesn’t prevent you from taking the Rush Action.

features.name: Fearmonger
features.description: When you kill an Enemy, every Near Enemy with HD lower than your Level becomes Frightened until the end of your next Turn.

features.name: Mindless Rancor
features.description: You can’t be Charmed, Confused, Frightened, or compelled to act against your will.

features.name: Bloodthirsty
features.description: Your attacks against Beings that are missing any HP are Favored, and you can sense them within Far as if by Blindsight.

features.name: Rip and Tear
features.description: While Berserk, you gain a +1 bonus to each die of damage you deal, and you reduce damage you take by 1 per damage die. This stacks with the benefits of Rage.
